scope: Macro anatomy and posed cross-view coherence only; finish, temporal animation, assembled cinematic and actual phone framing are separate gates.

evidence.inspectionOrder: All original pixels reviewed before any claims or numeric geometry validation.

shoulder.evidence: Both clay opposites and flight45/225/pose17 show elongated tapered scapular root replacing short broad capped cuff. It still has a stylized muscular boundary, but no detached cap or bell-shaped insertion.

dorsalCheekFins.evidence: Profiles and bank show broad-rooted asymmetric swept blades, replacing pebbles and ear discs. Natural edge-on narrowing remains, but broad faces and buried bases are coherent in opposite views.

neck.evidence: Shared neck/skull remains continuous. Minor underside curvature/shading band is visible but does not create the previous cut boundary or separate collar.
